text.description_html:
Hamilton DBP-104-BP Arched Doorbell Button Plate

This bronze patina doorbell button plate is 2-1/2" wide by 3-3/4" high. It is cast in solid bronze. The arched design makes this doorbell button cover a simple and inexpensive way to add classic elegance to your home. It is easy to install with the matching finish mounting screws; and is made with the attention to quality that Hamilton Sinkler is known for.

Specifications for Hamilton DBP-104-BP Bronze Doorbell Cover:

  • Total Height: 3-3/4"
  • Total Width: 2-1/2"
  • 3/8" Thick Solid Bronze
  • Finish: Bronze Patina
  • Packaged with matching finish mounting screws
  • Hamilton DBP-104-BP Dimensions (PDF)
